title: Morphisms of flat semisimplicial cartesian derived objects
statement:
Use the semisimplicial ringed total category $\mathscr M$ and its derived evaluations $e_n$ of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category]. Assume every transition module pullback $f_\alpha^*$ is exact. Let $B,C\in D(\mathscr M)$ be cartesian and put $B_n=e_nB$, $C_n=e_nC$. Assume $\operatorname{Hom}(B_n,C_n[t])=0$ for every $n\ge0$ and every $t<0$. Then evaluation induces a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathscr M)}(B,C)\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ \{(v_n)_{n\ge0}: v_n:B_n\to C_n,\ \ v_n\theta^B_\alpha=\theta^C_\alpha Lf_\alpha^*v_m\ \text{for every }\alpha:[m]\hookrightarrow[n]\}.$$
In particular a global morphism whose degree-zero evaluation is zero is zero.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), injective-order-map adaptation: their Postnikov simplex resolution and degree-dependent negative Hom hypotheses are implied by the displayed all-negative vanishing. The semisimplicial version is agent-supplied.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-cartesian-simplex-filtration] to $B$, and use its $X_p,F_N,u_N,j_N,S,s,p,\partial$. By [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-evaluation-free-adjoint], for every $r>0$,
$$\operatorname{Hom}(X_p[r],C)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(B_p,C_p[-r])=0.$$
Thus all shifts used below are covered by the given negative Hom assumption. The first-stage map $j_0:X_0\to B$ is the counit, so a composite $X_0\xrightarrow{j_0}B\to C$ is adjoint to its degree-zero evaluation.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), with the full proofs of lemma-nullity-cartesian-objects-derived and lemma-hom-cartesian-objects-derived; injective-order-map adaptation.

proof.text:
Take a compatible family $(v_n)$. Let $a_0:X_0=F_0\to C$ be adjoint to $v_0$ under [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-evaluation-free-adjoint]. For $i=0,1$ the adjunct of $a_0q_i:X_1\to C$ is
$$\theta^C_{\delta_i}Lf_{\delta_i}^*(v_0)(\theta^B_{\delta_i})^{-1}=v_1.$$
Here the equality is precisely the supplied compatibility for $\delta_i$; the adjunct formula is the labelled-summand formula of that node. Therefore $a_0(q_0-q_1)=0$. Apply clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] to the first-stage triangle of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-cartesian-simplex-filtration]. It gives $a_1:F_1\to C$ with $a_1u_0=a_0$.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), with the full proofs of lemma-nullity-cartesian-objects-derived and lemma-hom-cartesian-objects-derived; injective-order-map adaptation.

proof.text:
Suppose $N\ge1$ and compatible $a_0,\ldots,a_N$ have been chosen. Rotate the filtration triangle to
$$X_{N+1}[N]\longrightarrow F_N\xrightarrow{u_N}F_{N+1}\longrightarrow X_{N+1}[N+1].$$
The first term has no maps to $C$ by Step 1 since $N>0$. Clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] therefore extends $a_N$ to $a_{N+1}$. Starting with Step 2 and making these choices recursively gives a compatible sequence for all $N$. These are rotations of the triangles supplied by [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-cartesian-simplex-filtration]; the sign on the rotated first map has no effect on its zero composite.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), with the full proofs of lemma-nullity-cartesian-objects-derived and lemma-hom-cartesian-objects-derived; injective-order-map adaptation.

proof.text:
On the coproduct $S$ of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-cartesian-simplex-filtration], define $a:S\to C$ by $a\iota_N=a_N$. Then
$$a(1-s)\iota_N=a_N-a_{N+1}u_N=0$$
for every $N$, hence $a(1-s)=0$ by the coproduct universal property. Clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact], applied to its telescope triangle, supplies $\gamma:B\to C$ with $\gamma p=a$. Consequently $\gamma j_0=a_0$, and [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-evaluation-free-adjoint] identifies $e_0\gamma$ with $v_0$.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), with the full proofs of lemma-nullity-cartesian-objects-derived and lemma-hom-cartesian-objects-derived; injective-order-map adaptation.

proof.text:
Derived evaluation and the transitions of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category] are functorial, so $(e_n\gamma)$ is a compatible family. For any injection $\alpha:[0]\hookrightarrow[n]$, the two compatibility equations and $e_0\gamma=v_0$ give
$$e_n\gamma\,\theta^B_\alpha=\theta^C_\alpha Lf_\alpha^*(v_0)=v_n\theta^B_\alpha.$$
Cancel the isomorphism $\theta^B_\alpha$. Such an injection exists for every $n\ge0$; therefore $e_n\gamma=v_n$ for every $n$. This proves surjectivity of the displayed evaluation map.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), with the full proofs of lemma-nullity-cartesian-objects-derived and lemma-hom-cartesian-objects-derived; injective-order-map adaptation.

proof.text: We now prove uniqueness, including the final degree-zero assertion. First $\operatorname{Hom}(F_N[1],C)=0$ for every $N$: at $N=0$ this is Step 1, and the filtration triangle shifted by one has outer terms $F_N[1]$ and $X_{N+1}[N+2]$. Both have zero Hom into $C$, so the middle term does too, by clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact]. Here and below the triangles are those of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-cartesian-simplex-filtration]. Explicitly a map from the middle term, zero on the first, factors through the third and hence is zero.

source.place: Tags 0D9R (lemma-nullity-cartesian-modules-derived) and 0D9S (lemma-hom-cartesian-modules-derived), with the full proofs of lemma-nullity-cartesian-objects-derived and lemma-hom-cartesian-objects-derived; injective-order-map adaptation.

proof.text: Let $w:B\to C$ satisfy $e_0w=0$. The counit identification of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-evaluation-free-adjoint] gives $wj_0=0$. If $wj_N=0$, clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] applied to the filtration triangle shows $wj_{N+1}$ factors through $X_{N+1}[N+1]$. Step 1 kills this factor, hence induction gives $wj_N=0$ for all $N$. Therefore $wp=0$ on every coprojection of $S$. Clause (ii) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact], applied to the telescope triangle $S\xrightarrow{1-s}S\xrightarrow{p}B\xrightarrow{\partial}S[1]$ of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-cartesian-simplex-filtration] with $wp=0$, gives $k:S[1]\to C$ with $w=k\partial$. By the coproduct property of $S[1]$ stated there, $k$ is determined by its restrictions $k\,\iota_N[1]$ to the $F_N[1]$, each zero by Step 6; thus $k=0$ and $w=0$. Apply this to the difference of two morphisms with the same evaluations. This proves injectivity and the stated final assertion.
